title: Two community projects join the directory
summary:
Two community projects joined the directory, while the MCP and audio guides got more useful.

The project lists now include Aiphoto智能绘画, which makes images from Chinese-language descriptions, and SingodiyaTech, a Telegram bot offering AI features.

The MCP guides now list Pink Pixel’s community-maintained MCPollinations server alongside the official server, with installation details. The website guide also drops an outdated Node.js image and audio example.

The text-to-speech POST docs now show that `/openai` returns JSON containing base64-encoded audio at `choices[0].message.audio.data`, rather than a raw MP3. The cURL, Python, and JavaScript examples show how to decode it.
